data_source.title: Hugging Face dataset thetrademarkk/india-index-options-1m
data_source.note: Free community data (licence CC BY-NC 4.0: credit the authors, no commercial use): NIFTY 1-minute index and weekly option candles. It is for educational use and has not been checked against NSE.

cost_schedule.source: Estimate. STT 0.05%, NSE option charge ~0.053%; check against contract notes.
Estimate. Stamp duty 0.003% from 1 Jul 2020; exchange charge approximate.
STT 0.15% (Finance Act 2026, NSE/FATAX/73524); NSE total same (NSE/FA/73061).

rules.title: Signal
rules.text: 9-EMA crossing the 21-EMA on a closed spot bar (NIFTY index). Bars are the selected timeframe, built from 1-minute candles anchored at 09:15. The EMAs run continuously across days (they are not reset each morning) and start from the first close. A tie (EMAs equal) keeps the previous direction; the very first direction is not a cross.

rules.title: Which bar triggers the fill
rules.text: The decision is made when the signal bar closes. The order fills at the open of the option's 1-minute candle that starts at that moment. If that candle is missing, the next candle within 5 minutes is used; otherwise the trade is skipped and listed (never invented).

rules.title: Entry window
rules.text: Signals before the start time or after the cutoff are ignored (inclusive at both ends). A cross before the start time does not carry into the window. The cutoff only blocks new entries; open trades still exit normally.

rules.title: Exit and reversal
rules.text: A trade exits on the opposite crossover, or at the 15:00 square-off. An opposite cross inside the window closes the trade and opens the reverse one immediately. A cross that completes at 15:00 or later is not acted on: square-off wins.

rules.title: Contracts
rules.text: Nearest weekly expiry on or after the trade date (expiry day itself is 0 DTE and is traded). ATM = signal-bar close rounded to the nearest 50 (ties go up). ITM 5 = five strikes (250 points) in the money. Buy modes: bullish buys a call, bearish buys a put. ATM sell: bullish sells a put, bearish sells a call.

rules.title: Sizing and friction
rules.text: 1 lot = 65 units. Each leg pays 0.5% of the premium plus 0.5 points slippage (buys round up, sells round down to the 0.05 tick, never below 0.05), then the full cost stack: brokerage, STT, exchange charges, SEBI fee, stamp duty and GST at the rates in force on the trade date.

rules.title: Gross vs net
rules.text: Gross P&L uses the raw candle prices. Net P&L = gross - slippage - regulatory charges. Win rate, profit factor and the other KPIs are on net P&L.

rules.title: No trade, no data
rules.text: Days with fewer than 375 spot minutes are excluded (and listed). A signal with no usable option price, no listed expiry or a corrupt price is skipped and listed with the reason. Nothing is silently dropped.

rules.title: What is not modelled
rules.text: No stop-loss or target, no bid/ask spread beyond the slippage setting, no partial fills, no margin or liquidity limits. Max drawdown is on realised P&L only.
